desc: Built to perform under various conditions, the M&P15 SBR is as versatile as it is reliable. Engineered for demanding professional applications. The M&P15 SBR offers more options to accessorize than the previous generations. Lightweight and rugged, the M&P15 SBR embodies the best combination of function and form. Featuring a forged, integral trigger guard, an Armornite finish on the barrel, a chromed firing pin, a forward assist, and a dust cover. Get unmatched value with the new M&P15 SBR.
